title: Conductive material dispersion and secondary battery manufactured using the same
abstract: The present invention provides a conductive material dispersion liquid containing: a conductive material containing bundled carbon nanotubes; a dispersant containing hydrogenated nitrile-based rubber; and a dispersion medium, and a secondary battery manufactured using the same When measured by a rheometer at a frequency of 1 Hz, the complex modulus (|G*| at 1 Hz) is 20-500 Pa. The conductive material dispersion liquid has a controlled complex modulus to exhibit excellent dispersibility and powder resistance characteristics, and as a result, the output characteristics of the battery can be greatly improved.
